name: R01 Freight Revenue by Commodity Group

statements:
SELECT
  FISCAL_PERIODS.FISCAL_YEAR,
  FISCAL_PERIODS.PERIOD_NUMBER,
  COMMODITY_GROUPS.BUSINESS_SEGMENT,
  COMMODITY_GROUPS.GROUP_NAME,
  SUM(FREIGHT_BILLING.LINE_REVENUE),
  SUM(FREIGHT_BILLING.CARLOADS)
FROM
  CNR_FIN.COMMODITIES  COMMODITIES,
  CNR_FIN.COMMODITY_GROUPS  COMMODITY_GROUPS,
  CNR_FIN.FISCAL_PERIODS  FISCAL_PERIODS,
  CNR_FIN.FREIGHT_BILLING  FREIGHT_BILLING
WHERE
  ( FREIGHT_BILLING.COMMODITY_CODE=COMMODITIES.COMMODITY_CODE  )
  AND  ( COMMODITIES.GROUP_CODE=COMMODITY_GROUPS.GROUP_CODE  )
  AND  ( FREIGHT_BILLING.PERIOD_ID=FISCAL_PERIODS.PERIOD_ID  )
GROUP BY
  FISCAL_PERIODS.FISCAL_YEAR,
  FISCAL_PERIODS.PERIOD_NUMBER,
  COMMODITY_GROUPS.BUSINESS_SEGMENT,
  COMMODITY_GROUPS.GROUP_NAME

variables.name: Segment Code
variables.formula: =If([Business Segment]="Bulk") Then "BLK" ElseIf([Business Segment]="Merchandise") Then "MER" Else "INT"
